mapper.sql: SELECT oppt_id,oppt_no,oppt_nm,cust_ptnr_id,bsn_part_id,bsn_chrg_user_id AS owner_user_id, bsn_stg_cd,win_prblt_rt,expc_amt,cntrct_ty_cd,expc_bgn_ym AS bgn_ym,expc_mnth_qty AS mth_cnt, next_work_desc AS next_action,next_work_ddln_dt AS next_action_dt,rmrk_desc,oppt_stts_cd,win_prj_id,created_at,updated_at, amount_difference_reason,quot_aprv_stts_cd AS approval,expc_sls_amt AS revenue,expc_cst_amt AS cost,expc_mrgn_rt AS margin, aprv_mrgn_rt AS approved_margin,aprv_at AS approved_at,zero_cost_evidence AS evidence,zero_cost_validation AS validation,lost_rsn_desc,rjct_rsn_desc FROM bsn.oppt WHERE oppt_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT need_id,job_cd,grd_cd,psn_cnt,bgn_ym,mnth_qty AS mth_cnt,mth_mm_qty, expc_untprc_amt,psn_mth_cst_amt,min_untprc_amt,trgt_untprc_amt,rmrk_desc FROM bsn.oppt_need WHERE oppt_id=#{id} AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,need_id
SELECT aprv_prcs_cd AS action,opnn_desc AS opinion,prcs_user_id AS user_id, prcs_at AS created_at,mrgn_rt AS expc_mrgn_rt FROM bsn.quot_aprv_hist WHERE oppt_id=#{id} ORDER BY prcs_at,aprv_hist_id

SELECT c.mth_cst_id AS id,c.dev_id AS developer,c.cst_ym AS month, c.indv_lbr_cst_amt::numeric AS labor,coalesce((SELECT sum(e.expns_amt) FROM cst.drct_expns e WHERE e.dev_id=c.dev_id AND e.expns_ym=c.cst_ym),0)::numeric AS expense, d.main_job_cd AS job,d.grd_cd AS grade FROM mst.dev d JOIN LATERAL (SELECT m.mth_cst_id,m.dev_id,m.cst_ym,m.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM cst.mth_cst m WHERE m.dev_id=d.dev_id AND m.cst_ym<=to_char(#{today},'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY m.cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true WHERE d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt>#{today}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt<=#{today} AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt>=#{today})) ORDER BY d.dev_id
SELECT num_val FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id='QUOTE_APPROVAL_RATE' AND aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bsn.oppt ${column}=#{value},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE oppt_id=#{id} AND oppt_stts_cd='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT need_id FROM bsn.oppt_need WHERE oppt_id=#{id} ORDER BY need_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
mapper.update: UPDATE asgn.tmpr_asgn t SET tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='RELEASED',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} FROM bsn.oppt_need n WHERE n.need_id=t.need_id AND n.oppt_id=#{id} AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT t.tmpr_asgn_id AS id,t.need_id,t.dev_id,t.bgn_ym,t.end_ym,t.mm_qty,n.job_cd,n.expc_untprc_amt AS price FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=t.need_id WHERE n.oppt_id=#{id} AND t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.tmpr_asgn_id FOR UPDATE OF t
mapper.update: UPDATE asgn.tmpr_asgn SET tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='CONVERTED',asgn_id=#{assignment},updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tmpr_asgn_id=#{id} AND tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE'
UPDATE prj.prj SET oppt_id=#{id},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE prj_id=#{project}
